description: The release lists lenders with at least 50 applications in one state or metro area for one loan group. It includes their figures and counts. The caller chooses one sort key. The list never combines keys.

area.description: A five-digit metro area code or a two-letter state code identifies the area.

limit.description: The limit sets how many lenders to return, up to 50.

segment.description: Loan group id, for example purchase_first or refinance_first.

sort.description: The caller chooses one sort key: applications, name, denial, spread or costs.

name: list_lenders_in_area
title: list lenders in area
